shift.$description: Slide, Bounce and Stagger: how far content travels as it opens or closes.

blur.$description: Blur: how out of focus closed content is.

unfoldAngle.$description: Unfold: how far content is folded back while closed.

bounceScale.$description: Bounce: content's scale while closed, springing to full size as it opens.

staggerStep.$description: Stagger: delay between each piece of content appearing.
